workOrders.reason.lineDropped: After the plan was changed or adjusted, this line is no longer in the new plan
workOrders.reason.archived: Project "{name}" is archived, so its maintainer takes no new work orders. To continue, unarchive it on the project page and start again.
workOrders.timeline.created: Created work order {order} → project "{project}" (stage {stage}; sent when the stage starts)
workOrders.timeline.awaiting: Unplanned work order {order} → project "{project}" is waiting for your confirmation
workOrders.timeline.unplannedDirect: Unplanned work order {order} → project "{project}": beyond approval but let through, sent directly
workOrders.timeline.confirmed: You confirmed sending unplanned work order {order} → project "{project}"
workOrders.timeline.declined: You declined unplanned work order {order} → project "{project}"; it wasn't sent
workOrders.timeline.undispatched: Work order {order} → project "{project}" ended without being sent
workOrders.timeline.undispatchedReason: Work order {order} → project "{project}" ended without being sent: {reason}
workOrders.timeline.lineDropped: The line for work order {order} → project "{project}" was removed from the plan, so it no longer holds up stage {stage}
workOrders.forward.intro: The maintainer of project "{project}" asked this in work order {id} "{title}". The task maintainer couldn't answer, so it's passed on to you
workOrders.forward.inboxTitle: Question passed on by the task maintainer: {title}
workOrders.forward.wait: Waiting for you to answer the passed-on question
workOrders.forward.dismissedSummary: Closed the question card passed on for work order {order}; the task maintainer answers on its own judgment
workOrders.unplanned.wait: Waiting for you to confirm an unplanned work order
workOrders.unplanned.cardText: Unplanned work order {id} → project "{project}": {title} (task "{task}", stage {stage}; acceptance: {acceptance})
workOrders.unplanned.notAwaiting: This work order is no longer waiting for your confirmation
workOrders.returns.judged: A work order was returned or couldn't be done
workOrders.returns.redispatch: Changed approach: sent a new work order to project "{project}" (the previous one, {previous}, {outcome})
workOrders.returns.dropped: Changed approach: revised the plan and removed the line(s) for {orders}
workOrders.writeBack.noSummary: no session summary written with {tool} yet
workOrders.writeBack.escalated_one: The maintainer was reminded {nudges} time but still didn't update the project records. This session ({segment}) ended without them, and it's been handed to you to decide (see "Stuck, needs help" in Inbox).
workOrders.writeBack.escalated_other: The maintainer was reminded {nudges} times but still didn't update the project records. This session ({segment}) ended without them, and it's been handed to you to decide (see "Stuck, needs help" in Inbox).
workOrders.writeBack.escalatedOrder_one: The maintainer was reminded {nudges} time but still didn't update the project records. This session ({segment}) ended without them, work order {order} ended as usual, and it's been handed to you to decide (see "Stuck, needs help" in Inbox).
workOrders.writeBack.escalatedOrder_othe: The maintainer was reminded {nudges} times but still didn't update the project records. This session ({segment}) ended without them, work order {order} ended as usual, and it's been handed to you to decide (see "Stuck, needs help" in Inbox).
workOrders.writeBack.helpTitle: Stuck, needs help: the maintainer of project "{name}" didn't update the project records
workOrders.writeBack.helpWhat: When {what} ended, the maintainer of project "{name}" still hadn't written what it learned back to the project records despite reminders ({missing}).
workOrders.writeBack.helpQueueOrder: The work order ended as usual and the project's queue moves on; what was learned in this session may not be in the files, so the next session can only rebuild from the files and the previous summary.
workOrders.writeBack.helpQueue: The project's queue moves on; what was learned in this session may not be in the files, so the next session can only rebuild from the files and the previous summary.
workOrders.writeBack.helpFix: You can ask it to update the progress notes in the maintainer chat, or reset the maintainer on the project page.
workOrders.writeBack.unwrittenReset: Session {segment}{which} ended without updating the project records: the maintainer was reset mid-way, and the work order still counts as done
workOrders.writeBack.unwrittenNudged: Session {segment}{which} ended without updating the project records: the reminder limit was reached, so it was handed to you to decide
workOrders.unreviewed.summary: This session wasn't scope-reviewed before the reset
workOrders.unreviewed.detail: Session {segment} (work order {order}) ended without a scope review: the maintainer was reset, so this work (apart from what was reviewed during compaction) wasn't checked against the charter, plan and approvals
workOrders.ownJudgement.summary: Closed the question card of work order {order}; the maintainer continues on its own judgment
